notes: I changed the first-character uppercasing to use `.title()` instead of `.upper()`. The evidence: `"ßeta"→"Sseta"` (not `"SSeta"`), `"ﬁle"→"File"` (not `"FIle"`), and `"ǆungla"→"ǅungla"` (titlecase digraph, not uppercase `"Ǆ"`). These all match Python's `.title()`/`.capitalize()` semantics for the first character, while the rest of the string uses `.lower()`.
